## Implementation Closure Review

Project: `projects/<project>/`

### Reviewer checklist

- [ ] All required approved scope is verified.
- [ ] All approved closure criteria are satisfied.
- [ ] Blocking conditions are resolved.
- [ ] Traceability is valid.
- [ ] Material contradictions are resolved.
- [ ] Historical closure state is not being used to override current evidence.
- [ ] No new closure criteria or scope were invented.

### Decision

- [ ] CLOSE
- [ ] CLOSE_WITH_GAPS
- [ ] REOPEN
- [ ] BLOCKED
- [ ] REJECT
